div.div: ضَوَائِعُ , applied to camels, (O, K,) and to other beasts, (O,) Lean, and lank in the belly: (O, K:) or emaciated: (TA:) app. from ضَاعَ said of journeying, meaning “ it rendered lean, or emaciated: (O:) by rule it should be ضَائِعَةٌ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
